claims.claim: Analysis of data from more than 2,500 people showed that common medications including antidepressants and anxiety treatments altered gut microbiome composition, with some effects persisting years after use.
claims.episode_span: Researchers analyzed data from more than 2,500 people and found that common drugs including antidepressants, blood-pressure medications and anxiety treatments altered gut microbiome composition. Some anxiety medications produced effects comparable in scale to broad-spectrum antibiotics. The microbial changes persisted years after participants stopped taking the drugs.
claims.source_title: Common medications may secretly rewire your gut, with effects lasting for years
claims.supporting_quote: Medications taken years or even long ago may leave lasting changes in your gut microbiome, according to a study of more than 2,500 people.

claims.claim: A cytochrome P450 enzyme named CcCYP9Z273 in leaf beetles converts pregnenolone to caraumbellogenin via C14-hydroxylation and is required for cardenolide formation.
claims.episode_span: A cytochrome P450 enzyme named CcCYP9Z273 in the leaf beetle Chrysolina coerulans converts pregnenolone to caraumbellogenin through C14-hydroxylation. Gene silencing of CcCYP9Z273 blocked cardenolide formation in the beetles.
claims.source_title: A cytochrome P450 is essential for cardenolide biosynthesis in Chrysolina beetles
claims.supporting_quote: Here we report the identification of a cardenolide biosynthetic enzyme from the leaf beetle Chrysolina coerulans. This cytochrome P450, CcCYP9Z273, catalyzes an array of steroid oxidations, including the conversion of pregnenolone into caraumbellogenin through C14-hydroxylation.

claims.claim: Every one-year increase in the Grim2AA DNA methylation clock raised cardiovascular disease event hazard by 6 to 11 percent in a large cohort.
claims.episode_span: Every one-year increase in the Grim2AA DNA methylation clock raised the hazard of cardiovascular disease events by 6 to 11 percent. The association was measured in a large cohort followed for incident events.
claims.source_title: For every 1-year increase in the DNA methylation clock Grim2AA, the hazards of cardiovascular disease events…
claims.supporting_quote: For every 1-year increase in the DNA methylation clock Grim2AA, the hazards of cardiovascular disease events increase 6 - 11%

claims.claim: A review of 40 studies found people with type 2 diabetes face a 53 percent higher risk of Alzheimer’s, with nearly five cases per 1,000 patients per year.
claims.episode_span: A review of 40 studies found people with type 2 diabetes face a 53 percent higher risk of developing Alzheimer’s disease. Researchers calculated that nearly five of every 1,000 people with type 2 diabetes develop Alzheimer’s each year.
claims.source_title: Type 2 diabetes linked to 53% higher Alzheimer’s risk, major review finds
claims.supporting_quote: People with type 2 diabetes face a 53% higher risk of developing Alzheimer’s disease, according to a major new review of 40 studies.

claims.episode_span: Clinicians identified a previously unrecognized inherited retinal condition that progressively damages peripheral and night vision while sparing central vision for years.
